items.Sentence: five 50,000-gallon fiberglass settling tanks are to be installed and operated in series.
Orenco Bio-tube filters will be attached to the outlets of the settling tanks to further remove solids prior to wastewater entering the pre-anoxic tanks.
two 50,000-gallon pre-anoxic tanks, where primary treated effluent will be blended with recirculated filtered effluent from the AX-Max filtration units to provide denitrification.
Secondary treatment is performed using Orenco AX-Max textile filtration units as proposed in the original design.
The UV disinfection system has been upgraded from the UV Pure Hallett 30 to the UV Pure Hallett 1000 for longer lamp life and larger system capacity.
Sludge generated during the treatment process will be pumped and hauled to a dewatering facility
pumped and hauled to a dewatering facility to be combined with biosolids from other municipal facilities and dewatered.
Dried biosolids will be hauled from the dewatering facility to a Class B landfill for disposal.
